Governance Risk Compliance

データ主体

An individual whose personal data is collected, held or processed by a data controller or processor as defined by privacy laws (e.g., GDPR).

Questions and answers

What is データ主体?

In this glossary, データ主体 refers to: An individual whose personal data is collected, held or processed by a data controller or processor as defined by privacy laws (e.g., GDPR).

How is データ主体 used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "各データ主体は、適用されるプライバシー規制の下で、自分の個人データにアクセス、修正、または削除する権利があります。"

Definition

An individual whose personal data is collected, held or processed by a data controller or processor as defined by privacy laws (e.g., GDPR).
